# RoboFang — Full Reference

RoboFang MCP & robotics orchestration hub. Multi-service: bridge (FastAPI),
supervisor, fleet orchestration, plugins (15+), connectors (13 services),
RAG (LanceDB), voice bridge (kyutai-mcp), Tauri desktop app (NSIS).

## Services

| Service | Port | Role |
|---------|------|------|
| Bridge API + MCP | 10871 | FastAPI REST + MCP streamable HTTP |
| Hub web dashboard | 10870 | Vite React frontend (robofang-hub) |
| Supervisor | 10872 | Heartbeat, auto-restart, metrics |
| MCP thin server | 10873 | robofang-mcp webapp frontend |

## Entry Points

- `uv run robofang` -> robofang.cli:main
- `uv run robofang-bridge` -> robofang.main:main (FastAPI + MCP, PORT=10871)
- `uv run robofang-supervisor` -> robofang.supervisor:app
- `uv run robofang-mcp` -> robofang_mcp.server:main (thin MCP server)

## MCP Tools

- `robofang_status` — bridge health, connector counts, version
- `robofang_help` — multi-level help by category + topic
- `robofang_ask` — send message to orchestrator (use_council, use_rag)
- `robofang_fleet` — fleet registry: connectors, domain agents, summary
- `robofang_deliberations` — recent reasoning log (Council/ReAct)
- `robofang_agentic_workflow` — multi-step goal via sampling (status/ask/fleet/deliberations)
- `robofang_voice` — voice relay to kyutai-mcp (turn, briefings, service control, sessions)

## MCP Prompts

- `robofang_quick_start` — step-by-step hub setup
- `robofang_council_workflow` — Council of Dozens (Enrich -> Execute -> Audit)
- `robofang_voice_workflow` — voice pipeline guide

## Configuration

| Variable | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| `PORT` / `MCP_PORT` | Bridge port (default 10871 / 10867) |
| `ROBOFANG_HOST` / `ROBOFANG_BRIDGE_HOST` | Bind host |
| `ROBOFANG_SUPERVISOR_URL` | Supervisor endpoint |
| `ROBOFANG_API_KEY` | API authentication |
| `ROBOFANG_BRIDGE_URL` | Bridge URL for thin MCP server |
| `ROBOFANG_CORS_ORIGINS` | Extra CORS origins (comma-separated) |
| `ROBOFANG_TAURI` | Set to 1 when spawned by Tauri |
| `ROBOFANG_CONNECTORS` | Comma-separated connector list |
| `ROBOFANG_HANDS_DIR` | Override hands directory |
| `ROBOFANG_FLEET_MANIFEST` | Fleet manifest YAML path |
| `ROBOFANG_FLEET_REGISTRY` | Fleet registry path |
| `ROBOFANG_FLEET_OWNER` | Fleet owner name |
| `ROBOFANG_REPOS_ROOT` | Repos root directory |
| `ROBOFANG_VAULT_SECRET` | Vault encryption key |
| `ROBOFANG_VAULT_DEV_SECRET` | Dev fallback vault secret |
| `ROBOFANG_VAULT_DB` | Vault DB path |
| `ROBOFANG_LANCEDB_PATH` | LanceDB storage path |
| `ROBOFANG_FOREMAN_SECRET` | Council foreman signing secret |
| `ROBOFANG_BASTIO_API_KEY` | Bastio gateway API key |
| `ROBOFANG_DISCORD_WEBHOOK` | Discord webhook URL |
| `ROBOFANG_DISCORD_AGENTS_CHANNEL_ID` | Discord agents channel |
| `ROBOFANG_TELEGRAM_TOKEN` | Telegram bot token |
| `ROBOFANG_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID` | Telegram chat ID |
| `ROBOFANG_AUTO_LAUNCH_CONNECTORS` | Auto-launch connectors flag |
| `ROBOFANG_SKIP_GREETING` | Skip startup greeting |
| `ROBOFANG_SUPERVISOR_PROCESS` | Set to 1 for supervisor process |
| `MOLTBOOK_API_KEY` | Moltbook API key |
| `OLLAMA_URL` | Ollama endpoint |
| `RESONITE_HOST` / `RESONITE_PORT` | Resonite connection |
| `DEFAULT_MODEL` | Default LLM model |
| `HA_URL` / `HA_TOKEN` | Home Assistant connection |
| `PLEX_URL` / `PLEX_TOKEN` | Plex connection |
| `DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN` | Discord bot token |
| `SLACK_BOT_TOKEN` | Slack bot token |
| `KYUTAI_BACKEND_URL` | Kyutai backend URL |
| `KYUTAI_MCP_URL` | Kyutai MCP URL |
| `SUPERVISOR_PORT` | Supervisor HTTP port |

## Connectors (13)

Ring, Hue, Tapo (Kasa), Plex, Resonite, Discord, Slack, Shelly, Home
Assistant, Calibre, Email, Moltbook, Bridge (MCP-to-MCP relay)

## Plugins (15+)

Avatar, Cooking, Dance, Doctor, Housemaker, Musician, PA, Patroller,
Routine Runner, Robotics Hand, Discord, Slack, Reddit, Teams, WhatsApp,
Zoom, RustDesk

## Tests

- `pytest` — run test suite (~25 files: core, connectors, integration, E2E)
- Tests use `asyncio_mode = auto`, 30s timeout, markers for github/integration

## Architecture

- Bridge (FastAPI) serves REST API + mounts FastMCP at /mcp (streamable HTTP)
- Supervisor handles heartbeat, auto-restart, Prometheus /metrics
- Hub (robofang-hub) is Vite React on port 10870
- Tauri desktop wrapper in native/ (NSIS installer, embedded backend)
- Connectors are stateless HTTP clients abstracted behind base class
- Plugins add domain-specific capabilities (avatar, dance, cooking, etc.)
